_comment: Campaign PC1: headless dashboard + tshark + per-phase journals. Step 1 = local providers (harness.Prov); step 2 adds providers.source = remote (agent on PC2) and ziel2_fault.netdown.

providers._comment: source: local = testbed_provider.py started on this PC by the runners; remote = via provider_agent on PC2 (step 2, not implemented yet)

background._comment: C++ providers in VirtualBox (bridged), started by hand with --room ICU-1 --patient-id P009. Not controlled, not measured; only their discovery/decision is noted. Fewer than 'expect' discovered = warning.

capture._comment: interface: auto = Npcap loopback when providers are local, else the adapter that owns 'ip'; or an index / device string / alias substring from 'tshark -D'. filter: auto = 'host {ip}' (local) or 'host {provider_host} or udp port 3702' (remote); placeholders {ip} {provider_host} allowed in an explicit filter. provider_ports = TCP ports counted as request/response; other TCP = notifications to the dashboard. enabled: auto|off.

network._comment: variant C (campaign.py --listen / --merge): PC 2 runs pc2_scheduler.py with schedule_c.json; the capture on the NIC that owns 'ip' keeps only traffic with PC 2 plus discovery multicast; the local full run keeps dossier_target above

netdown._comment: step 2: real network loss via the PC2 agent
